effects.trigger: Upon depositing fifty cents US currency into the coin slot
constraints: the user deposits fifty cents US currency
the user enters the name of a liquid
it can only deliver substances that can exist in liquid state

evidence.locator: Upon depositing fifty cents US currency into the coin slot, the user is prompted to enter the name of any liquid using the touchpad.
It is of note that after approximately fifty uses, the machine would not respond to further requests.

effects.target: a fluid in a sealed container
constraints: the fluid is placed in a sealed container 25 meters away

evidence.locator: The fluid was created and placed in a sealed container 25 meters away from SCP 294.

constraints: a person requests the best drink they have ever had

evidence.locator: In his briefing, Agent ████████ confirmed that his favorite drink ever was a Vienna lager he consumed at the beach with his friends.

effects.trigger: Dr. Menchu produced request for "cup of D-151839's leukemia"
constraints: a second identical request resulted in an OUT OF RANGE error

evidence.locator: D-151839 was subsequently found to be free of leukemia; however, within 15 days, the leukemia had recurred.
